adkit.description: Ads MCP Server by AdKit: hosted MCP server. Run ads on Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, Microsoft, Reddit, X and Pinterest from Claude Code. Sign in with your AdKit account through OAuth; there is no key to paste. Every change is saved as a draft until you approve it. Paid plans start at $29/month, with a 7-day free trial and a free demo of 50 actions. Docs: https://adkit.so/features/ads-mcp
